title: 列出项目仓库
summary: 按项目编码列出已关联的 GitLab 仓库。
description: Use the immutable project_code from the prompt. Results are local project metadata; page starts at 1 and page_size defaults to 20.
result_description: items with project_repo_id, conn_id, name, full_path, default_branch and connection_enabled, plus page, page_size and total.
